note: VARIANT C — DECISIVE three-way pipeline. Full n=3,453, all 8 classes incl EUS, augmentations included, seed 42, cached captions, FAITHFUL 𝒪 (ADR-0012e Option B: caption ∪ top-1 KB doc text). The pipeline runs the full Stage-3 decision (Eq. 11 retrieval-margin valve theta=0.02, then Eq. 10 three-way on S_h/S_d with T_h=2, m=1) — NOT a forced-choice argmax. An Inconclusive verdict is a distinct outcome that counts as NON-correct in DA and McNemar (mirroring Overall DA counting abstentions as misses). This is the configuration hypothesised to match how the manuscript defined 'Pipeline' (DA=0.811, 0.6pp below kNN lambda0.7). Table (c) adds the third manuscript test: kNN lambda0.7 k=5 vs lambda1.0 k=5 majority vote. Original manuscript counts are under 'original_manuscript'.
